title.narrative: IOM. Technical assistance to develop the capacity of the government on immigration and border management in Sudan. 2020-2023.

description.narrative: IOM. Technical assistance to develop the capacity of the government on immigration and border management in Sudan. 2020-2023.

The objective of this project is to enhance Sudan’s capacity to manage migration practices that respect national sovereignty, the rule of law, obligations under international law, and the human rights of all migrants. Specifically the project will enhance the rollout and implementation of the MIDAS border management information systems to capacitate Sudan to obtain additional data on migrant stocks and flows, documenting migration patterns and trends, characteristics of migrants as well as drivers and impact of migration. The project seeks to enhance knowledge and capacity development of relevant agencies and stakeholders on different border management and governance issues, including examining documents for fraud, identifying imposters, human trafficking and smuggling of migrants, the Sudanese legal framework on counter-trafficking, dealing with the victims of trafficking and vulnerable migrants.
